THE PUNJAB COMMUNICATION AND WORKS 
DEPARTMENT (ENGINEERING POSTS QUALIFICATION
AND CONDITIONS FOR RECRUITMENT) RULES, 1985)
CONTENTS
Schedule

GOVERNMENT OF THE PUNJAB 
SERVICES GENERAL ADMINISTRATION AND
INFORMATION DEPARTMENT
[14th November, 1985]
NOTIFICATION

No.SOR-III-1-8/72.- In exercise of the powers conferred on him by section 23 of the 
Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974, and in pursuance of the provisions of rule 3 of the 
Punjab Civil Servants (Appointment and Conditions of Service) Rules, 1974, the 
Governor of the Punjab is pleased to make the following rules, namely:-
THE PUNJAB COMMUNICATION AND WORKS DEPARTMENT (ENGINEERING
POSTS QUALIFICATIONS AND CONDITIONS FOR RECRUITMENT) RULES,

1. 
These rules may be called the Punjab Communication & Works Department 
(Engineering Posts Qualifications and Conditions for Recruitment) Rules, 
1985.

2. 
They shall come into force at once.

3. 
The method of recruitment, minimum qualifications, age limit and other matter 
related thereto the posts shall be as given in the schedule annexed.

4. 
The following rules are hereby repealed:-

i) 
The West Pakistan Service of Civil Engineers (Buildings & Roads) 
(Class-I) Rules, 1967.

ii) 
The West Pakistan Service of Civil Engineers (Buildings & Roads) 
(Class-II) Rules, 1967.

iii) 
The Punjab Public Works Department, Buildings & Roads Branch, 
Subordinate Engineering Service (Recruitment and Conditions of 
Service) Rules, 1943.

iv) 
The West Pakistan Buildings Department Subordinates Engineering 
Service (Electrical & Mechanical) Rules, 1969.
BY ORDER OF THE GOVERNOR OF THE PUNJAB
ADDITIONAL CHIEF SECRETARY
